text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Pardon me, I was just chuckling at 
a memory. Actually, during the break, I 
went to the villa with everyone from the 
Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We went for walks and chatted. It was so 
much fun, but during the card game that 
night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The faces of everyone being so utterly 
captivated are just so adorable...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll have to dedicate myself to 
training so I can take you on in races as 
well♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan looks like she had a 
wonderfully fulfilling day off!
